answer: Cryptographic sortition draws a fresh validator committee each epoch from a verifiable random beacon, so an attacker cannot predict which identities will grade or attest. Entry requires persistent stake locked in an ivory bond, and a sybil farm splitting capital across N clones sees its selection probability fall superlinearly because the beacon samples identities, not balances. The crystal clarity of revealed VRF outputs forms a public audit delta—anyone can re-run selection and challenge a committee that was never actually drawn.
